style: True pixel art, 16-bit era isometric-free flat side view, strict pixel grid, 1-pixel dark outline on every object, about 24 colours, flat 2-3 tone shading, no anti-aliasing, no dither, no glow, no text, no people, no characters. Same rendering style, palette and pixel size as the attached reference picture (a cut-away office floor): match colours and brush, ignore its composition.
roof: A very wide, low rooftop terrace of an office tower seen straight from the side (flat side elevation, no perspective), as ONE horizontal strip about 7 times wider than tall. Along the flat roof edge at the bottom, left to right and evenly spread across the whole width: a round water tank on four legs, a wooden bench, a striped parasol over a small round table, a big planter with a green shrub, a second wooden bench, a row of three small potted plants, a tall lattice construction-crane tower standing on the roof near the right end (tower only, NO jib arm, no hook), and a low railing with posts running along the whole bottom edge. Everything stands on a thin beige roof slab at the very bottom. The background above the objects is flat solid #FF00FF magenta (no magenta inside the objects). Objects are small and crisp, no big empty gaps.
basement: A very wide, low server-room cross-section seen straight from the side (flat side elevation, no perspective), as ONE horizontal strip about 6 times wider than tall, fully filled edge to edge (no transparent background): a dark blue-grey concrete back wall with a row of eight EMPTY dark rack alcoves evenly spread across the width (each alcove a recessed dark rectangle, nothing inside, with a lit-free dark floor line under it), cable trays and pipes running along the top, a few small wall warning plates, and a grey concrete floor strip along the bottom. No server hardware, no screens, no people, no text.
exterior-day: The front of a tall modern office tower seen straight from the front in daylight, a tall rectangle taller than wide, standing alone on a small beige pavement at the bottom with a glass double door at the centre of the ground floor and an empty dark sign board above the door (no text on it), nine floors above it each with a regular grid of five windows in a row, every window showing closed pale blue window blinds, a flat roof with a small water tank and a crane tower, sunny blue sky with two small white clouds around it. Fully opaque picture, sky filled.
exterior-night: The same front of the same tall modern office tower, same composition and same positions as the attached day image, at night: deep navy sky with a crescent moon and a few small stars, the building walls darker, ALL windows dark and unlit, except the two windows left of the glass double door on the ground floor which are lit warm yellow, the glass door softly lit too, the sign board above the door dark with no text. Flat pixel lights only, no glow. Painted a bit brighter than a realistic night.
